Prediction - mnist20pct - Confusion matrix

using Jchemo, JchemoData
using JLD2, CairoMakie
using FreqTables 
using CodecZlib   # required since mnist20pct.jld2 is compressed

Import data

path_jdat = dirname(dirname(pathof(JchemoData)))
db = joinpath(path_jdat, "data/mnist20pct.jld2") 
@load db dat
@names dat

(:Xtrain, :ytrain, :Xtest, :ytest)

Xtrain = dat.Xtrain
ytrain = string.(Int.(dat.ytrain))
Xtest = dat.Xtest
ytest = string.(Int.(dat.ytest))
ntrain, p = size(Xtrain)
ntest = nro(Xtest)
ntot = ntrain + ntest
(ntot = ntot, ntrain, ntest)

(ntot = 14000, ntrain = 12000, ntest = 2000)

Example of one observation (= one unfolded image):

plotsp(Xtrain, 1:p; nsamp = 1, xlabel = "Pixel", ylabel = "Grey level").f

Fitting a Pls-Qda and prediction of the test set

model = plsqda(nlv = 25)
fit!(model, Xtrain, ytrain)
@head pred = predict(model, Xtest).pred

3×1 Matrix{String}:
 "1"
 "0"
 "4"
... (2000, 1)
